answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The timber is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the cipher. Reaching the spiral of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
